TASK ORDER FOR S3 - EXCHANGE SUPPORT FOR THE OFFICE OF THE UNDER SECRETARY FOR INFRASTRUCTURE.

THIS FUNDING IS ON A PARTNERSHIP INTERMEDIARY AGREEMENT. THIS PROJECT ORDER IS TO IDENTIFY SMALL INVESTOR-OWNED ELECTRIC UTILITIES (IOUS), SPECIFICALLY THOSE IOUS SELLING LESS THAN 4,000,000 MEGAWATT HOURS OF ELECTRICITY PER YEAR WITHIN THE UNITED STATES AND ITS TERRITORIES. WORKING WITH CYBERSECURITY, ENERGY SECURITY, AND EMERGENCY RESPONSE (CESER), THE INTERMEDIARY WOULD ASSIST CESER IN MEETING ITS OBLIGATION TO INFORM THESE SMALL IOUS ABOUT OPPORTUNITIES TO RECEIVE FINANCIAL AND TECHNICAL ASSISTANCE UNDER THE RURAL AND MUNICIPAL ADVANCED CYBERSECURITY GRANT AND TECHNICAL ASSISTANCE PROGRAM (RMUC).
